description: Create blog-quality diagrams and data charts (architecture flows, data structure cards, grouped bar charts) as plain HTML, then export them to PNG with a playwriter-based CLI. Ships two styles: claude-style (Anthropic engineering blog look, light) and nextjs-style (Next.js docs look, dark). Use when the user wants a diagram, chart, figure, infographic or data visualization image for a blog post, docs or social, especially "Anthropic style", "Claude style", "Next.js style" or a dark diagram.
